decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service sits far from the maritime core and shows no reported results, and the superyacht recruitment service has already been dropped, so it falls short of aspiration; growth and slack let the firm carry it a little longer while problemistic search for other uses of its recruitment resources continues.
The Smart Academy is growing its partner network quickly and builds on the firm's training-centre strength, so its results meet aspiration and it should be kept.
FuelEU monitoring and compliance is a regulatory necessity close to the core offer, and all plans were transferred on time, so performance exceeds aspiration.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL software and supports the firm's digitalisation and environmental strategy at low marginal cost, so slack and strategic fit justify keeping it.
The cost simulation tool complements the compliance offering within PAL, and its results are still uncertain but cheap to carry, so the firm keeps it while FuelEU demand builds.
